name: Kothari Fermentation and Biochem Limited
about: Kothari Fermentation and Biochem Limited manufactures and sells yeast and its derivatives in India. The company offers fresh compressed, instant, and inactive dried yeast; live yeast; oligo saccharides; cell walls; yeast autolyzate extract powder; yeast extract powder; molasses dried yeast; and distiller dried yeast under the Kothari SUNRISE, KF, SUPER FAST INSTANT YEAST, ALCOMAX DISTILLER'S INSTANT YEAST, and FOUR SEASONS brand names. Its products are used in bakeries, feeds, alcohol fermentation, food, distillery, pharmaceuticals, veterinary, and biotechnology industries. In addition, the company exports its products. Kothari Fermentation and Biochem Limited was incorporated in 1990 and is based in New Delhi, India.
